label.zh-TW: 稅前利益佔實收資本比率
label.en: Profit before tax to paid-in capital ratio

teacherLabel: 稅前利益佔實收資本比率
currentTwLabel: 稅前純益占實收資本額比率

zh-TW: 稅前利益占實收資本比率
稅前純益占實收資本額比率

note.zh-TW: 「佔」照教材，「占」的寫法收進別名。
note.en: The course uses one of the two interchangeable characters for the word share; the other spelling is kept as an alias.

definition.zh-TW: 稅前淨利相對於股東實收資本的比率，看股東投入的本錢賺回多少稅前獲利。數值越高表示資本的獲利能力越強。
definition.en: Profit before tax relative to the shareholders' paid-in capital: how much pre-tax profit the capital contributed has earned. Higher means the capital is more profitable.

ifrsNote.zh-TW: IFRS 不定義財務比率；這個名稱是國際通用說法，計算口徑以指標登錄檔的版本為準。
ifrsNote.en: IFRS does not define financial ratios. The name follows international usage; the calculation basis is the version in the ratio registry.
